root_cause.summary: Kaggle assigned Tesla P100-PCIE-16GB with capability sm_60 even though the notebook metadata requested T4. The runner rejected capability < 7 before training.
root_cause.traceback_summary: RuntimeError: SFT-v9 candidate requires a T4-or-newer Kaggle GPU for the installed PyTorch wheel; received Tesla P100-PCIE-16GB with capability sm_60.

fix.summary: Accept Pascal-or-newer Kaggle GPUs and record precision mode; P100 uses fp16_pascal, T4-or-newer uses fp16_tensor_core.

next_step: Rebuild the SFT-v9 Kaggle bundle and push a new smoke kernel version.
